n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())
Mod = mod - 2

factorial = [1] * (n + 1)
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    factorial[i] = factorial[i - 1] * i % mod

def qpow(a, b):
    res = 1
    while b:
        if b & 1:
            res = res * a % mod
        a = a * a % mod
        b >>= 1
    return res

InvFactorial = [1] * (n + 1)
InvFactorial[n] = qpow(factorial[n], Mod)
for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
    InvFactorial[i] = InvFactorial[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod

C = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
C[0][0] = 1
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    C[i][0] = 1
    C[i][i] = 1
    for j in range(1, i):
        C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j]) % mod

f = [0] * (m + 1)
g = [0] * (m + 1)
f[0] = 1
g[0] = 0

for i in range(1, m + 1):
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        s = (j * (j - 1) // 2 + (i - j + 1) * (i - j) // 2) % mod
        f[i] = (f[i] + f[j - 1] * f[i - j] % mod * (i + 1) % mod * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod
        g[i] = (g[i] + ((g[j - 1] * f[i - j] + f[j - 1] * g[i - j]) % mod * (i + 1) + f[j - 1] * f[i - j] % mod * s) % mod * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod

h = [[[0, 0] for _ in range(m + 1)] for _ in range(m + 1)]
h[0][0][0] = 1

limit = min(m, n - m + 1)
for i in range(limit):
    for j in range(m):
        for k in range(1, m - j + 1):
            F = f[k] * C[j + k][j] % mod
            h[i + 1][j + k][0] = (h[i + 1][j + k][0] + h[i][j][0] * F) % mod
            h[i + 1][j + k][1] = (h[i + 1][j + k][1] + h[i][j][1] * F) % mod
            h[i + 1][j + k][1] = (h[i + 1][j + k][1] + h[i][j][0] * g[k] % mod * C[j + k][j]) % mod

ans = 0
for i in range(1, limit + 1):
    ans = (ans + h[i][m][1] * C[n - m + 1][i]) % mod

print((ans + mod) % mod)
